Luscious No-Bake Lemon Cheesecake
By: ravikumar
Published: Tuesday, October 31, 2017 - 1:41am

Ingredients




1 cup – digestive biscuits
1 cup – condensed milk
2 limes – to make zest
1 tbsp – butter
1 tsp – heaped gelatin dissolved in water
2 cup – cream cheese
2 tbsp – gondhoraj lebu juice

Preparation

1 This fresh lemon cheesecake is the perfect dessert for your summer house parties! 2 Method: 3 1.  Crush the digestive biscuits, add melted butter and press the mixture on the bottom of a cheesecake mold. 4 2. Refrigerate for 10 min. 5 3. While the base is chilling, prepare the cheesecake mixture by whipping the cream cheese and condensed milk. 6 4. Heat the soaked gelatin in a double boiler till the gelatin melts. Add this to the cream cheese mixture. 7 5. Add the gondharaj lebu juice and zest. 8 6.Pour it on the prepared cheesecake mold with the biscuit bottom. 9 7.Refrigerate for 2 hours. 10 8. Slice and serve.

About

Try this!! It is an all-time favourite cheesecakes! It also is the simplest Luscious No-Bake Lemon Cheesecake recipe you can find. This is a quick, delicious and easy recipe to make. The taste is so refreshing.  If you love lemon and cheesecake you're going to love this awesome recipe of Luscious No-Bake Lemon Cheesecake.
